title: Bunny's Rainbow Hop
note: Times are the working plan. After the full song is generated, edit start/end per scene (and per line) to match measured vocals, then re-run tools/build.py. Any lyric edit must be logged in docs/lyrics_changes.md.

scenes.action: Bunny peeks from giant flower; 3 colorful bubbles float toward camera
lines: What bright colors can you see?

scenes.action: Red apple bounces twice on the beat; Bunny follows in surprise
lines: Bounce it left and bounce it right!

scenes.action: Friendly yellow sun peeks from behind a cloud; Bunny stretches paws up
lines: Stretch your little paws up high!

scenes.action: Bunny taps foot in blue puddle; round drops jump like music notes
lines: Tap your toes and splash away!

scenes.action: Green Frog on a leaf joins in small hops
Purple butterfly lands on Bunny's nose; tickle scrunch; it flutters off
lines: Wave your hands and say, ‘Hi, hi!’

scenes.action: Five colors form a fantasy rainbow bridge; Bunny points, colors glow on softly
Three hops across colored stones; numbers 1,2,3 appear on landings
lines: Clap your hands and sing our song!

scenes.action: Bunny and Frog face viewer, clap, wiggle ears and arms
lines: Happy friends are you and me!

scenes.action: Bunny waves and hops back into the flower; frame matches opening
